canon_ref.note: The sweeping Worker saw Erin's chess 'yesterday' (day 13), so the dig is the night of day 14. The Hive's reason is not given.

b1.antinium_uncover_ruin_door.summary: Monsters break into a Hive tunnel for the fifth time this week and kill most of a Worker crew. That night Klbkch secretly leads twenty Workers out of Liscor to a hillside, where they dig out a huge ancient door, then collapse the tunnel so the door looks exposed by chance.
